speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are experiencing frequent nosebleeds, bleeding from your mucous membranes, and a rash of tiny red spots called petechiae. To understand the cause, have you noticed any easy bruising or bleeding after minor injuries?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old male. The child's parent reports that the child has been experiencing frequent episodes of nosebleeds and has had several instances of bleeding from the gums. Additionally, there have been occurrences of unexplained bruising and petechiae, primarily on the distal extremities.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Immune Thrombocytopenia (ITP)

The clinical presentation of mucosal bleeding (gums, nose), petechiae on the extremities, and easy bruising in a 4-year-old is highly suggestive of thrombocytopenia. To confirm this, I need to see the platelet count immediately. REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count_with_platelet_count.
